accounting_contract.costs: fees plus separately reported embedded slippage; never deduct slippage twice
accounting_contract.cycles: entire BUY lot exhausted by normal SELL, excluding risk-exit contamination
accounting_contract.differences: Grid minus each preregistered control on funding-adjusted account profit
accounting_contract.drawdown: max(1 - NAV / running peak), including initial capital
accounting_contract.exposure: marked signed position and absolute notional at each observation
accounting_contract.funding_nav: NAV + cumulative signed observed funding cashflows
accounting_contract.inventory: FIFO lots, age at common end, residual inventory marked not force-filled
accounting_contract.nav: initial capital + realized PnL + unrealized PnL - fees; slippage in fill price

parameters.activation_rule: new immutable financial version; never mutate this engineering version

comparison_contract.attribution: Paper simulation, statistical inference and Demo execution are distinct
comparison_contract.capital: one initial capital and one predeclared notional cap for all accounts
comparison_contract.cash: same initial capital, zero trading/funding and zero assumed interest
comparison_contract.costs: one fee/slippage schedule and settlement evidence for all accounts
comparison_contract.fixed_hold: quantity frozen before start, never fitted to future mean inventory
comparison_contract.lagged_exposure: prior observed Grid target only; execute on later observation
comparison_contract.window: identical UTC half-open [start,end), mark and observation clock

parameters.execution_rule: orders generated at a close execute only on later observations
parameters.funding_rule: observed settlements only; post-hoc overlay is not executable cash
parameters.missing_data_rule: BLOCK; do not interpolate or silently shorten window
